description: telekomunikacijsko omrežje WFS is a dataset listed in INSPIRE Metadata System Slovenia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by storitve.eprostor.gov.si. The portal shows the English title as "INSPIRE WFS telecommunications network" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include infoFeatureAccessService. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-metadata-si.
